temporaryChoices: Every meaning and namespaceQualifier is explicitly laboratory metadata, not paraphrased canonical meaning. specDigest is SHA-256 of the exact primary source file bytes, not of this meaning.
Files, ObjectGenesis and seal IndexSpecs are not fully pinned by their field-model documents. This candidate uses the explicit lists below (Files/seal backlinks for every role; no scalar indexes).

G11 specifies seal field order only: this candidate chooses hashes/Realm/roots as BYTES_FIXED(32), address as BYTES_FIXED(20), Principal as PRINCIPAL, admission high as UINT(8), exact typed record/object refs as shown. These are not claimed source-fixed MC/1 bytes.
ChunkTree count and size minima are zero under Files 7.2. The unique empty form remains a contextual profile check, not expressible by MC/1 INT_RANGE.
Route enum numeric codes and read/profile rules are not invented as MC/1 constraints; UINT(1) preserves the source width.
